svg.text: How we split it: five regions, all made at startup
Qwen3.6-27B on the 64 GB Mac mini. Nothing is allocated after startup; the arena's size (--arena-gib) is the one memory knob.
273 GB/s peak, one budget for all three
gets fp16 copies of one layer
Thin slivers are drawn wider than their size. Workspace: ~1 GB on the GPU path, ~3 GB more with ANE prefill (two sets of fp16 weight surfaces, ~0.9 GB each, plus Core ML). free = what macOS keeps.
